title.zh: 卷八 補帝紀第八 後主 幼主
title.raw: 卷八 補帝紀第八 後主 幼主 Volume 8 Annals 8: Houzhu; Youzhu

sentences.zh: 後主 幼主

translations.literal: Houzhu; Youzhu
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu; Youzhu

sentences.zh: 後主諱緯，字仁綱，武成皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: The Last Emperor, taboo name Wei, style name Rengang, was the eldest son of Emperor Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor, whose personal name was Wei and style name Rengang, was the eldest son of Emperor Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 母曰胡皇后，夢於海上坐玉盆，日入裙下，遂有娠。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Hu. She dreamed that she was sitting in a jade basin on the sea, and the sun entered beneath her skirt; thereupon she conceived.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Hu. She dreamed she was seated in a jade basin on the sea when the sun slipped beneath her skirt, and soon after she conceived.

sentences.zh: 天保七年五月五日，生帝於幷州邸。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Tianbao, the Emperor was born at the residence in Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of the Tianbao era, the emperor was born at the princely residence in Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 帝少美容儀，武成特所愛寵，拜王世子。

translations.literal: When young the Emperor had a fine appearance and bearing; Wucheng especially loved and favored him, and appointed him heir prince.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he was handsome in face and bearing, and Wucheng cherished him above all his children, appointing him heir prince.

sentences.zh: 及武成入纂大業，大寧二年正月丙戌，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Wucheng succeeded to the great enterprise, on the bingxu day of the first month of the second year of Daning, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Wucheng took the throne, on the bingxu day of the first month of the second year of the Daning era, the prince was formally established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 河清四年，武成禪位於帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Heqing, Wucheng abdicated the throne in favor of the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Heqing era, Wucheng abdicated the throne in his favor.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，彗星出文昌東北，其大如手，後稍長，乃至丈餘，百日乃滅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the renxu day, a comet appeared northeast of the Wenchang constellation; at first it was the size of a hand, then gradually lengthened until it reached more than ten feet; after a hundred days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renxu day, a comet appeared northeast of the Wenchang constellation. At first it was no larger than a hand, but it soon lengthened until it stretched more than ten feet, and only after a hundred days did it disappear.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍王季高使於陳。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wang Jigao as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wang Jigao as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，太上皇帝詔增置都水使者一人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict adding one Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict adding one Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸未，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太上皇帝詔改「太祖獻武皇帝」為「神武皇帝」，廟號「高祖」，「獻明皇后」為「武明皇后」；

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict changing "Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu" to "Emperor Shenwu," with the temple name Gaozu, and "Empress Xianming" to "Empress Wuming";
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict changing "Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu" to "Emperor Shenwu," with the temple name Gaozu, and "Empress Xianming" to "Empress Wuming";

sentences.zh: 其「文宣」諡號委有司議定。

translations.literal: as for the posthumous title "Wenxuan," that was to be decided by the relevant offices through deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: as for the posthumous title "Wenxuan," that was left to the relevant offices to determine through deliberation.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，太上皇帝狩於北郊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor hunted at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor hunted at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，狩於南郊。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, he hunted at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, he hunted at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，狩於西郊。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, he hunted at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, he hunted at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, the Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有司奏改「高祖文宣皇帝」為「威宗景烈皇帝。」

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the relevant offices memorialized that "Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan" should be changed to "Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the relevant offices memorialized that "Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan" should be changed to "Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong."

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、契丹、靺鞨並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, the Khitan, and the Mojie all sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Goguryeo, the Khitan, and the Mojie all sent envoys to pay court tribute.

sentences.zh: 河南大疫。

translations.literal: A great epidemic struck Henan.
translations.idiomatic: A great epidemic struck Henan.

sentences.zh: 二年丙戌春正月辛卯，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: In year 2, the bingxu year, spring, first month, on the xinmao day, he sacrificed at the Round Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the first month of spring in the second year (bingxu), he sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，袷祭於太廟，詔降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, he performed the xia sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple; an edict reduced the sentences of convicts by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, he performed the joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict reduced the sentences of convicts by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以吏部尚書尉瑾為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Minister of Personnel Yu Jin was appointed Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Minister of Personnel Yu Jin was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚子，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，太上皇帝詔以三臺施興聖寺。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the Three Towers to Xingsheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the Three Towers to Xingsheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 以旱故，降禁囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, imprisoned convicts had their sentences reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought, imprisoned convicts had their sentences reduced.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，陳文帝殂。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Emperor Wen of Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Emperor Wen of Chen died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，以兼尚書左僕射、武興王普為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, Concurrent Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat and Prince Pu of Wuxing was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and Prince Pu of Wuxing was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封太上皇帝子儼為東平王，仁弘為齊安王，仁堅為北平王，仁英為高平王，仁光為淮南王。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the retired emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Yan as Prince of Dongping, Renhong as Prince of Qi'an, Renjian as Prince of Beiping, Renying as Prince of Gaoping, and Renguang as Prince of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the retired emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Yan as Prince of Dongping, Renhong as Prince of Qi'an, Renjian as Prince of Beiping, Renying as Prince of Gaoping, and Renguang as Prince of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 六月，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍韋道儒聘於陳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wei Daoru on a friendly mission to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wei Daoru on a friendly mission to Chen.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，乙太保侯莫陳相為太傅，大司馬、任城王湝為太保，太尉婁叡為大司馬，徙馮翊王潤為太尉，開府儀同三司韓祖念為司徒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Houmo Chenxiang was appointed Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal and Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Grand Preceptor; Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal; Prince Run of Fenyang was transferred to Grand Commandant; and Han Zunian, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Houmo Chenxiang was made Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal and Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Grand Preceptor; Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal; Prince Run of Fenyang was transferred to Grand Commandant; and Han Zunian, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 十一月，大雨雪，盜竊太廟御服。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, heavy rain and snow fell; the imperial vestments in the Ancestral Temple were stolen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, heavy rain and snow fell, and the imperial vestments in the Ancestral Temple were stolen.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺河間王孝琬。

translations.literal: That year, Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was executed.

sentences.zh: 突厥、靺鞨國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The Turks and the Mojie both sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks and the Mojie both sent envoys to pay court tribute.

sentences.zh: 於周為天和元年。

translations.literal: In Zhou's reckoning, it was the first year of Tianhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the Northern Zhou calendar, it was the first year of the Tianhe era.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬辰，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In year 3, spring, first month, on the renchen day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the first month of spring in the third year, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大雪，平地二尺。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, heavy snow fell; on level ground it lay two feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, heavy snow fell until level ground lay buried two feet deep.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太上皇帝詔京官執事散官三品已上各舉三人，五品已上各舉二人；

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, the retired emperor issued an edict that metropolitan officials in executive posts and honorary officials of rank three and above were each to recommend three men, and those of rank five and above were each to recommend two;
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the retired emperor issued an edict that metropolitan officials in executive posts and honorary officials of rank three and above were each to recommend three men, and those of rank five and above were each to recommend two;

sentences.zh: 稱事七品已上及殿中侍御史、尚書都檢校御史、主書及門下錄事各舉一人。

translations.literal: officials titled as responsible for affairs of rank seven and above, as well as palace secretaries, inspector-generals of the Secretariat, clerks, and recorder-clerks of the Gate Office were each to recommend one person.
translations.idiomatic: officials with the title of responsible functionary of rank seven and above, as well as palace secretaries, inspector-generals of the Secretariat, clerks, and recorder-clerks of the Gate Office were each to recommend one person.

sentences.zh: 鄴宮九龍殿災，延燒西廊。

translations.literal: The Nine Dragons Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, which spread to burn the western corridor.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Dragons Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, and the blaze spread to burn the western corridor.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅朔，帝加元服，大赦，九州職人各進四級，內外百官普進二級。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day of the renyin month, the Emperor assumed adulthood; a general amnesty was proclaimed; craftsmen of the nine provinces were each promoted four ranks, and officials civil and military were universally promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day of the renyin month, the emperor came of age. A general amnesty was proclaimed; craftsmen of the nine provinces were each promoted four ranks, and officials civil and military were universally promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍司馬幼之使於陳。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Sima Youzhi as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Sima Youzhi as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，太上皇帝詔以領軍大將軍、東平王儼為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing General-in-Chief of the Palace Guard and Prince Yan of Dongping as Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing General-in-Chief of the Palace Guard and Prince Yan of Dongping as Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大風晝晦，發屋拔樹。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, a great wind darkened the day, tore off roofs, and uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, a great wind darkened the sky in broad daylight, tore roofs from houses, and uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，太上皇帝詔封皇子仁幾為西河王，仁約為樂浪王，仁儉為潁川王，仁雅為安樂王，仁統為丹陽王，仁謙為東海王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict enfeoffing the imperial princes: Renji as Prince of Xihe, Renyue as Prince of Lelang, Renjian as Prince of Yingchuan, Renya as Prince of Anle, Rentong as Prince of Danyang, and Renqian as Prince of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict enfeoffing the imperial princes: Renji as Prince of Xihe, Renyue as Prince of Lelang, Renjian as Prince of Yingchuan, Renya as Prince of Anle, Rentong as Prince of Danyang, and Renqian as Prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 閏六月辛巳，左丞相斛律金薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on the xinsi day, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on the xinsi day, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太上皇帝詔尚書令、東平王儼錄尚書事，以尚書左僕射趙彥深為尚書令，幷省尚書左僕射婁定遠為尚書左僕射，中書監徐之才為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Chief Minister of the Secretariat and Prince of Dongping Yan recorder of the affairs of the Secretariat; Zhao Yanshen, Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Lou Dingyuan, Left Deputy Director of the Jinyang Secretariat, was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat; and Xu Zhicai, Director of the Secretariat, was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the retired emperor ordered Chief Minister of the Masters of Writing Prince Yan of Dongping to serve as recorder of the Masters of Writing; Zhao Yanshen, left deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was made chief minister; Lou Dingyuan, left deputy director of the Jinyang Masters of Writing, was made left deputy director; and Xu Zhicai, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未，太上皇帝詔乙太保、任城王湝為太師，太尉、馮翊王潤為大司馬，太宰段韶為左丞相，太師賀拔仁為右丞相，太傅侯莫陳相為太宰，大司馬婁叡為太傅，大將軍斛律光為太保，司徒韓祖念為大將軍，司空、趙郡王叡為太尉，尚書令、東平王儼為司徒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Grand Guardian Prince Jun of Rencheng as Grand Preceptor; Minister of War Prince Run of Fenyang as Grand Marshal; Grand Mentor Duan Shao as Left Chancellor; Grand Preceptor Hebaren as Right Chancellor; Grand Tutor Houmochen Xiang as Grand Mentor; Grand Marshal Lou Rui as Grand Tutor; Grand General Hulu Guang as Grand Guardian; Minister over the Masses Han Zunian as Grand General; Minister of Works Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery as Minister of War; and Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Yan of Dongping as Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor reshuffled the highest offices: Grand Guardian Prince Jun of Rencheng was appointed grand preceptor; Minister of War Prince Run of Fenyang, grand marshal; Grand Mentor Duan Shao, left chancellor; Grand Preceptor Hebaren, right chancellor; Grand Tutor Houmochen Xiang, grand mentor; Grand Marshal Lou Rui, grand tutor; Grand General Hulu Guang, grand guardian; Minister over the Masses Han Zunian, grand general; Minister of Works Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, minister of war; and Chief Minister Prince Yan of Dongping, minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，太上皇帝詔：「諸寺署所綰雜保戶姓高者，天保之初雖有優勑，權假力用未免者，今可悉蠲雜戶，任屬郡縣，一準平人。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, the retired emperor issued an edict: "Among the miscellaneous dependent households under the jurisdiction of the various monasteries and offices who bear the surname Gao, although at the beginning of the Tianbao era there were preferential edicts, those who on a provisional basis still had not been released from corvée labor—now all such dependent households may be wholly exempted; they shall be assigned to their prefectures and counties and treated entirely as ordinary commoners."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, the retired emperor proclaimed: "Among the miscellaneous dependent households registered to monasteries and government offices who bear the surname Gao, many were nominally favored at the opening of the Tianbao era yet still pressed into provisional labor service. Let all such households now be fully released from dependent status, placed under prefectural and county authority, and treated in every respect as ordinary subjects."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the retired emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the retired emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是秋，山東大水，人饑，僵尸滿道。

translations.literal: That autumn, great floods struck the eastern provinces; the people starved, and corpses filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn catastrophic floods inundated the eastern provinces. Famine followed, and the dead lay heaped along every road.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，突厥、大莫婁、室韋、百濟、靺鞨等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Tujue, Damolou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mojie, and other states each dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, envoys bearing tribute arrived from Tujue, Damolou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mojie, and other states.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，以晉陽大明殿成故，大赦，文武百官進二級，免幷州居城、太原一郡來年租賦。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, because the Daming Hall at Jinyang had been completed, a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were promoted two ranks, and the next year's land tax and corvée levies were remitted for Juzhou city and Taiyuan Commandery in Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, with the completion of Jinyang's Daming Hall, the court proclaimed a general amnesty, promoted all civil and military officials two ranks, and remitted the following year's land tax and corvée for Juzhou city and Taiyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the retired emperor arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，太上皇帝詔以故左丞相、趙郡王琛配饗神武廟庭。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the late Left Chancellor Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery posthumous sacrifice in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor ordered the late Left Chancellor Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery to receive posthumous cult in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，詔以故清河王岳、河東王潘相樂十人並配饗神武廟庭。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, an edict granted the late Prince Yue of Qinghe, Prince Pan of Hedong, Xiang Yue, and eight others posthumous sacrifice together in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, an edict granted the late Prince Yue of Qinghe, Prince Pan of Hedong, Xiang Yue, and eight others joint posthumous cult in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍鄭大護使於陳。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Zheng Dahu envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the retired emperor appointed Zheng Dahu, acting regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，太上皇帝詔以司徒、東平王儼為大將軍，南陽王綽為司徒，開府儀同三司徐顯秀為司空，開府儀同三司、廣甯王孝珩為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the third month, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Minister over the Masses Prince Yan of Dongping grand general; Prince Chuo of Nanyang minister over the masses; Xu Xianxiu, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, minister of works; and Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the third month, the retired emperor appointed Prince Yan of Dongping, minister over the masses, grand general; Prince Chuo of Nanyang, minister over the masses; Xu Xianxiu, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, minister of works; and Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, bearer of the same dignity, chief minister of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，鄴宮昭陽殿災，及宣光、瑤華等殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, the Zhaoyang Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, and the blaze spread to the Xuan'guang, Yaohua, and other halls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, fire consumed the Zhaoyang Hall of the Ye palace and spread to the Xuan'guang, Yaohua, and other halls.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the retired emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the retired emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，以尚書右僕射胡長仁為左僕射，中書監和士開為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fifth month, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Hu Changren was made Left Deputy Director, and Director of the Secretariat He Shikai was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fifth month, Hu Changren, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was made left deputy director, and He Shikai, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the retired emperor arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 自正月不雨至於是月。

translations.literal: From the first month until this month there had been no rain.
translations.idiomatic: From the first month until this month, not a drop of rain had fallen.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子朔，大雨。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the first of the sixth month, there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the new moon of the sixth month, torrential rains fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大風，拔木折樹。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, a great wind arose, uprooting trees and snapping trunks.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, a violent wind uprooted trees and snapped trunks.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗星見於東井。

translations.literal: That month, a comet appeared in the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet appeared in the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 秋九月丙申，周人來通和，太上皇帝詔侍中斛斯文略報聘于周。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on the bingshen day, Zhou envoys came seeking peace; the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Palace Attendant Hulu Siwenlue to return the mission of friendly inquiry to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the bingshen day, Northern Zhou envoys arrived seeking peace. The retired emperor dispatched Palace Attendant Hulu Siwenlue to Zhou on a return mission.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以尚書令、廣甯王孝珩為錄尚書，左僕射胡長仁為尚書令，右僕射和士開為左僕射，中書監唐邕為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of winter, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made recorder of the Secretariat; Left Deputy Director Hu Changren was made Chief Minister; Right Deputy Director He Shikai was made Left Deputy Director; and Director of the Secretariat Tang Yong was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of winter, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Hu Changren, left deputy director, was made chief minister; He Shikai, right deputy director, was made left deputy director; and Tang Yong, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍李翥使於陳。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Li Xu envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the retired emperor appointed Li Xu, acting regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳安成王頊廢其主伯宗而自立。

translations.literal: That month, Chen's Prince of Ancheng, Chen Xu, deposed his ruler Chen Bozong and enthroned himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen's Prince of Ancheng, Chen Xu, deposed his sovereign Chen Bozong and seized the throne for himself.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦，九州職人普加四級，內外百官並加兩級。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed; artisans of the nine provinces were all promoted four ranks, and civil and military officials throughout the court were each promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the court proclaimed a general amnesty, promoted artisans of the nine provinces four ranks each, and advanced every civil and military official two ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上太上皇后尊號為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the retired empress was honored with the title Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the retired empress was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔細作之務及所在百工悉罷之。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered that all fine-craft work and local artisan corvée be entirely suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict halted all luxury manufacture and local artisan corvée throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 又詔掖庭、晉陽、中山官人等及鄴下、幷州太官官口二處，其年六十已上及有癃患者，仰所司簡放。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that among the palace women of the Inner Quarters, Jinyang, and Zhongshan, and among the government household servants of the imperial kitchens at Ye and in Bing Province, those aged sixty or above and those suffering from chronic illness were to be screened and released by the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict directed the responsible offices to review and release all palace women of the Inner Quarters, Jinyang, and Zhongshan, and all imperial kitchen servants at Ye and in Bing Province, who were sixty years of age or older or afflicted with chronic infirmity.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔天保七年已來諸家緣坐配流者，所在令還。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered that all families implicated and sentenced to exile since the seventh year of Tianbao be commanded to return wherever they were held.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered the return of every family implicated and sent into exile since the seventh year of the Tianbao era.

sentences.zh: 是歲，契丹、靺鞨國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Khitan and Mojie each dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Khitan and Mojie.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛亥，詔以金鳳等三臺未入寺者施大興聖寺。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the xinhai day, an edict granted the three terraces of Jinfeng and others not yet converted into monasteries to the Daxingsheng Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the xinhai day, an edict granted the three Jinfeng terraces and other sites not yet turned into monasteries to the Daxingsheng Monastery.

sentences.zh: 是月，殺定州刺史、博陵王濟。

translations.literal: That month, Prince Ji of Boling, Inspector of Ding Province, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince Ji of Boling, inspector of Ding Province, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，詔應宮刑者普免刑為官口。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the second month, an edict universally exempted those liable to castration from punishment and enrolled them as government household servants.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month, an edict commuted all sentences of castration, enrolling the condemned instead as government household servants.

sentences.zh: 又詔禁網捕鷹鷂及畜養籠放之物。

translations.literal: Another edict forbade netting hawks and falcons and the keeping or training of birds for sport in cages.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict forbade the netting of hawks and falcons and the keeping or training of caged hunting birds.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大莫婁國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Damolou dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, envoys bearing tribute arrived from Damolou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，改東平王儼為琅邪王。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Prince Yan of Dongping was redesignated Prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Yan of Dongping was redesignated Prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 詔侍中叱列長叉使於周。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Palace Attendant Chile Changcha envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Palace Attendant Chile Changcha envoy to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，殺太尉、趙郡王叡。

translations.literal: That month, Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, Minister of War, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, minister of war, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，以司空徐顯秀為太尉，幷省尚書令婁定遠為司空。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the third month, Minister of Works Xu Xianxiu was made Minister of War, and Lou Dingyuan, Chief Minister of the Jinyang Secretariat, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the third month, Xu Xianxiu, minister of works, was made minister of war, and Lou Dingyuan, chief minister of the Jinyang Masters of Writing, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 是月，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: That month, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，詔以幷州尚書省為大基聖寺，晉祠為大崇皇寺。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, an edict converted the Jinyang Secretariat into the Daji Sheng Monastery and the Jin Shrine into the Dachong Huang Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, an edict converted the Jinyang Masters of Writing into the Daji Sheng Monastery and the Jin Shrine into the Dachong Huang Monastery.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，詔降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, an edict reduced the sentences of criminals, each according to his case.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, an edict reduced criminal sentences, each according to the merits of the case.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔使巡省河北諸州無雨處，境內偏旱者優免租調。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, an edict dispatched inspectors to tour the northern provinces of Hebei where rain had failed, granting preferential remission of land tax and corvée in districts suffering partial drought.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, an edict dispatched inspectors to tour the rainless districts of Hebei's northern provinces, granting preferential remission of land tax and corvée wherever drought had struck.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，詔禁造酒。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the tenth month of winter, an edict forbade the brewing of wine.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month of winter, an edict forbade the brewing of wine.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，詔乙太保斛律光為太傅，大司馬、馮翊王潤為太保，大將軍、琅邪王儼為大司馬。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, an edict appointed Grand Guardian Hulu Guang Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal Prince Run of Fenyang Grand Guardian; and Grand General Prince Yan of Langye Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, an edict appointed Grand Guardian Hulu Guang grand tutor, Grand Marshal Prince Run of Fenyang grand guardian, and Grand General Prince Yan of Langye grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，以開府儀同三司、蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, Prince Changgong of Lanling, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, Prince Changgong of Lanling, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以中書監魏收為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Director of the Secretariat Wei Shou was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Wei Shou, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，以百濟王餘昌為使持節、侍中、驃騎大將軍、帶方郡公，王如故。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the guihai day, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of Staff with Full Powers, Palace Attendant, General of Agile Cavalry, and Duke of Daifang Commandery; his kingship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guihai day, King Yuchang of Baekje was appointed bearer of staff with full powers, palace attendant, general of agile cavalry, and duke of Daifang Commandery, retaining his royal title.

sentences.zh: 己巳，乙太傅、咸陽王斛律光為右丞相，幷州刺史、右丞相、安定王賀拔仁為錄尚書事，冀州刺史、任城王湝為太師。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Grand Tutor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang was appointed Right Chancellor; Inspector of Bing Province, Right Chancellor, and Prince Hebaren of Anding was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; and Inspector of Ji Province and Prince Jie of Rencheng was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Grand Tutor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang was made right chancellor; Prince Hebaren of Anding, inspector of Bing Province and right chancellor, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; and Prince Jie of Rencheng, inspector of Ji Province, was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，降死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, sentences were reduced for all prisoners convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，隸尚書事、安定王賀拔仁薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing and Prince Hebaren of Anding died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Prince Hebaren of Anding, recorder of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以開府儀同三司徐之才為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Xu Zhicai, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Xu Zhicai, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, was made left deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙酉，以廣甯王孝珩為司空。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on the yiyou day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the yiyou day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以皇子恒生故，大赦，內外百官普進二級，九州職人普進四級。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, because of the death of the prince Heng, a general amnesty was proclaimed; all inner and outer officials were universally promoted two ranks, and functionaries of the nine provinces were universally promoted four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, mourning for the death of Prince Heng brought a general amnesty; every civil and military official was promoted two ranks, and every provincial functionary four.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以開府儀同三司唐邕為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, an edict appointed Tang Yong, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, an edict made Tang Yong, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，封孝昭皇帝子彥基為城陽王，彥康為定陵王，彥忠為梁郡王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, the sons of Emperor Xiaozhao were enfeoffed: Yanji as Prince of Chengyang, Yankang as Prince of Dingling, and Yanzhong as Prince of Liang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, Emperor Xiaozhao's sons were ennobled: Yanji as prince of Chengyang, Yankang as prince of Dingling, and Yanzhong as prince of Liang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以尚書令、蘭陵王長恭為錄尚書事，中領軍和士開為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Changgong of Lanling was made recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander He Shikai was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Prince Changgong of Lanling, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander He Shikai was appointed chief minister.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，靺鞨國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the Mojie sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, envoys from Mojie arrived to pay court tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以華山王凝為太傅。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Prince Ning of Huashan was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Prince Ning of Huashan was appointed grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，立皇子恒為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the prince Heng was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, Prince Heng was formally established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以司空、廣甯王孝珩為司徒，以上洛王思宗為司空，封蕭莊為梁王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Minister of Works Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister over the Masses; Prince Sizong of Shangluo was made Minister of Works; and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Prince Sizong of Shangluo was appointed minister of works; and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，曲降幷州死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below in Bing Province were partially reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, sentences were partially reduced for all prisoners in Bing Province convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復改威宗景烈皇帝諡號為「顯祖文宣皇帝。」

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the posthumous title of Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong was again changed to "Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan."
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the posthumous title of Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong was restored to "Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan."

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 詔右丞相斛律光出晉州道，修城戍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Right Chancellor Hulu Guang to go out by the Jinzhou route and repair fortifications and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Right Chancellor Hulu Guang to take the Jinzhou route and repair the frontier walls and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，詔兼散騎常侍劉環俊使於陳。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the dingsi day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Liu Huanjun as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month of spring in the second year, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Liu Huanjun as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以百濟王餘昌為使持節、都督、東青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of Staff with Full Powers, Commissioner-in-Chief, and Governor of Eastern Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, King Yuchang of Baekje was appointed bearer of staff with full powers, commissioner-in-chief, and governor of Eastern Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，以錄尚書事、蘭陵王長恭為太尉，幷省錄尚書事趙彥深為司空，尚書令和士開錄尚書事，左僕射徐之才為尚書令，右僕射唐邕為左僕射，吏部尚書馮子琮為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renyin day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Commandant; Zhao Yanshen of the Bing Secretariat, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister of Works; Chief Minister of the Secretariat He Shikai was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Left Deputy Director Xu Zhicai was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Right Deputy Director Tang Yong was made Left Deputy Director; and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day, Prince Changgong of Lanling, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made grand commandant; Zhao Yanshen of the Bing Masters of Writing, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister of works; Chief Minister He Shikai was made recorder; Left Deputy Director Xu Zhicai was made chief minister; Right Deputy Director Tang Yong was made left deputy director; and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong was made right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，以大司馬、琅邪王儼為太保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Yan of Langye was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Yan of Langye was appointed grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陳遣使連和，謀伐周，朝議弗許。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Chen dispatched envoys proposing an alliance to plan an attack on Zhou; the court deliberation did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, envoys from Chen arrived proposing an alliance for a joint campaign against Zhou, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 六月，段韶攻周汾州，克之，獲刺史楊敷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Duan Shao attacked Fen Province of Zhou, captured it, and took Governor Yang Fu prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Duan Shao attacked Zhou's Fen Province, captured it, and took Governor Yang Fu prisoner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，太保、琅邪王儼矯詔殺錄尚書事和士開於南臺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Grand Guardian Prince Yan of Langye used a forged edict to kill Recorder of the Masters of Writing He Shikai at the Southern Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Grand Guardian Prince Yan of Langye used a forged edict to kill He Shikai, recorder of the Masters of Writing, at the Southern Terrace.

sentences.zh: 卽日誅領軍大將軍厙狄伏連、書侍御史王子宣等，尚書右僕射馮子琮賜死殿中。

translations.literal: That same day Leading Army General Kudivolian, Secretary Attendant Censor Wang Zixuan, and others were executed; Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Feng Zicong was granted death in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Leading Army General Kudivolian, secretary-attendant censor Wang Zixuan, and others were put to death; Feng Zicong, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was ordered to take his own life in the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，罷京畿府入領軍府。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Capital Region Prefecture was abolished and merged into the Leading Army Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, the Capital Region Prefecture was abolished and absorbed into the Leading Army Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，詔侍中赫連子悅使於周。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict dispatched Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue as envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict dispatched Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue as envoy to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以徐州行臺、廣甯王孝珩錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, Provisional Secretariat of Xu Province, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, head of the Xu Province provisional secretariat, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以錄尚書事、廣甯王孝珩為司徒。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Recorder of the Masters of Writing Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以右丞相斛律光為左丞相。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己巳，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the jisi day, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the first month of spring in the third year, the emperor sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven in the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，追贈故琅邪王儼為楚帝。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the late Prince Yan of Langye was posthumously enfeoffed as Emperor of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the late Prince Yan of Langye was posthumously ennobled as emperor of Chu.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，以衛菩薩為太尉。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jimao day, Wei Pusa was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jimao day, Wei Pusa was appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以幷省吏部尚書元海為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Yuan Hai, Minister of Personnel of the Bing Secretariat, was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Yuan Hai, minister of personnel of the Bing Masters of Writing, was made right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以左僕射唐邕為尚書令，侍中祖珽為左僕射。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Left Deputy Director Tang Yong was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat, and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was made Left Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Left Deputy Director Tang Yong was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing, and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was appointed left deputy director.

sentences.zh: 是月，勑撰《玄洲苑御覽》，後改名《聖壽堂御覽》。

translations.literal: That month, an order was issued to compile the Imperial Reader of the Xuanzhou Garden; it was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: That month an order went out to compile the Imperial Reader of the Xuanzhou Garden, later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，詔文武官五品已上各舉一人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, an edict ordered civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above each to recommend one person.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, an edict required every civil and military official of the fifth rank or higher to recommend one candidate.

sentences.zh: 是月，周誅冢宰宇文護。

translations.literal: That month, Zhou executed the regent Yuwen Hu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou put the regent Yuwen Hu to death.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，誅左丞相、咸陽王斛律光及其弟幽州行臺、荊山公豐樂。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuchen day, Left Chancellor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang and his younger brother Fengle, Duke of Jingshan and Provisional Secretariat of You Province, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuchen day, Left Chancellor Prince Hulu Guang of Xianyang and his younger brother Fengle, duke of Jingshan and head of the You Province provisional secretariat, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，廢皇后斛律氏為庶人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, Empress Hulu was deposed and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, Empress Hulu was deposed and reduced to a commoner.

sentences.zh: 乙太宰、任城王湝為右丞相，太師、馮翊王潤為太尉，蘭陵王長恭為大司馬，廣甯王孝珩為大將軍，安德王延宗為司徒。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Right Chancellor; Grand Preceptor Prince Run of Fenyang was made Grand Commandant; Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Marshal; Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made Grand General; and Prince Yanzong of Ande was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Prince Jie of Rencheng was made right chancellor; Grand Preceptor Prince Run of Fenyang was appointed grand commandant; Prince Changgong of Lanling was made grand marshal; Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made grand general; and Prince Yanzong of Ande was appointed minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 使領軍封輔相聘於周。

translations.literal: Leading Army Commandant Feng Fuxiang was dispatched as envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Leading Army Commandant Feng Fuxiang was sent as envoy to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，拜右昭儀胡氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Right Imperial Concubine Lady Hu was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Right Imperial Concubine Lady Hu was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以司州牧、北平王仁堅為尚書令，特進許季良為左僕射，彭城王寶德為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Renjian, Prince of Beiping and Governor of Si Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Special Advancement Xu Jiliang was made Left Deputy Director; and Prince Baode of Pengcheng was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Renjian of Beiping, governor of Si Province, was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing; Xu Jiliang, special advancement, was appointed left deputy director; and Prince Baode of Pengcheng was made right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，《聖壽堂御覽》成，勑付史閣。

translations.literal: That month, the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity was completed, and an order was issued to deliver it to the historiography archives.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Sacred Longevity was completed and ordered deposited in the historiography archives.

sentences.zh: 後改為《修文殿御覽》。

translations.literal: It was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Cultivating Culture.
translations.idiomatic: It was later renamed the Imperial Reader of the Hall of Cultivating Culture.

sentences.zh: 九月，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, envoys from Chen arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，降死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the sentences of prisoners guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, sentences were reduced for all prisoners convicted of capital crimes or lesser offenses.

sentences.zh: 甲午，拜弘德夫人穆氏為左皇后，大赦。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Lady Mu, Lady of Expanded Virtue, was invested as left empress, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Lady Mu, lady of expanded virtue, was invested as left empress, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，廢皇后胡氏為庶人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Empress Hu was deposed and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Empress Hu was deposed and reduced to a commoner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，新羅、百濟、勿吉、突厥並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Silla, Baekje, Wuji, and the Turks all sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Silla, Baekje, Wuji, and the Turks.

sentences.zh: 於周為建德元年。

translations.literal: This corresponded to the first year of Jiande in Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou this was the first year of the Jiande era.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊寅，以幷省尚書令高阿那肱為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the wuyin day, Gao Anagutai, Chief Minister of the Bing Secretariat, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the first month of spring in the fourth year, Gao Anagutai, chief minister of the Bing Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔兼散騎常侍崔象使於陳。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Cui Xiang as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Cui Xiang as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄴都、幷州並有狐媚，多截人髮。

translations.literal: That month, demonic foxes appeared in both Ye and Bing Province, and many people had their hair cut off.
translations.idiomatic: That month demonic foxes were reported in Ye and Bing Province, and many people had locks of their hair mysteriously shorn off.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，拜左皇后穆氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the yisi day, Left Empress Lady Mu was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, Left Empress Lady Mu was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置文林館。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, the Wenlin Hall was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Wenlin Hall was established.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以尚書令、北平王仁堅為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Renjian of Beiping was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Prince Renjian of Beiping, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，周人來聘。

translations.literal: That month, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: That month envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，盜入信州，殺刺史和士休，南兗州刺史鮮于世榮討平之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinwei day, bandits entered Xin Province, killed Governor He Shixiu, and were suppressed by Xianyu Shirong, Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, bandits entered Xin Province, killed Governor He Shixiu, and were put down by Xianyu Shirong, governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，車駕至晉陽。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the imperial carriage arrived at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the emperor arrived at Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，以大司馬、蘭陵王長恭為太保，大將軍、定州刺史、南陽王綽為大司馬，太尉衛菩薩為大將軍，司徒、安德王延宗為太尉，司空、武興王普為司徒，開府儀同三司、宜陽王趙彥深為司空。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Changgong of Lanling was made Grand Guardian; Grand General Prince Chuo of Nanyang, Governor of Ding Province, was made Grand Marshal; Grand Commandant Wei Pusa was made Grand General; Minister over the Masses Prince Yanzong of Ande was made Grand Commandant; Minister of Works Prince Pu of Wuxing was made Minister over the Masses; and Zhao Yanshen, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors and Prince of Yiyang, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu day, Grand Marshal Prince Changgong of Lanling was appointed grand guardian; Grand General Prince Chuo of Nanyang, governor of Ding Province, was made grand marshal; Grand Commandant Wei Pusa was made grand general; Minister over the Masses Prince Yanzong of Ande was appointed grand commandant; Minister of Works Prince Pu of Wuxing was made minister over the masses; and Zhao Yanshen, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors and prince of Yiyang, was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祈皇祠壇壝蕝之內忽有車軌之轍，按驗傍無人跡，不知車所從來。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, within the enclosure of the imperial altar suddenly appeared the ruts of chariot wheels; on investigation there were no human tracks nearby, and no one knew whence the chariot had come.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, chariot wheel ruts suddenly appeared within the enclosure of the imperial altar; investigators found no human tracks nearby and could not tell whence the chariot had come.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔以為大慶，班告天下。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict proclaimed this a great auspice and announced it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, an edict declared the omen a great auspice and proclaimed it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，周人來聘。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，詔史官更撰《魏書》。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict ordered the historiographers to compile a new Book of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict ordered the historiographers to compile a new Book of Wei.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以領軍穆提婆為尚書左僕射，以侍中、中書監段孝言為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Leading Army Commandant Mutipo was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat, and Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Duan Xiaoyan was made Right Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Leading Army Commandant Mutipo was made left deputy director of the Masters of Writing, and Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Duan Xiaoyan was appointed right deputy director.

sentences.zh: 是月，開府儀同三司尉破胡、長孫洪略等與陳將吳明徹戰於呂梁南，大敗，破胡走以免，洪略戰沒，遂陷秦、涇二州。

translations.literal: That month, Yu Pohu, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, Zhangsun Honglue, and others fought the Chen general Wu Mingche south of Luliang and were greatly defeated; Pohu fled and escaped, Honglue died in battle, and thereafter Qin and Jing Provinces fell.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yu Pohu, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, Zhangsun Honglue, and others fought Chen general Wu Mingche south of Luliang and were routed; Pohu fled to safety, Honglue was killed in battle, and Qin and Jing Provinces soon fell.

sentences.zh: 明徹進陷和、合二州。

translations.literal: Mingche advanced and captured He and Hefei Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mingche pressed forward and captured He and Hefei Provinces.

sentences.zh: 是月，殺太保、蘭陵王長恭。

translations.literal: That month, Grand Guardian Prince Changgong of Lanling was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Grand Guardian Prince Changgong of Lanling was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月，明徹進軍圍壽陽。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Mingche advanced his army and besieged Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wu Mingche advanced and besieged Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸南苑，從官暍死者六十人。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the emperor visited the Southern Park; sixty attending officials died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the emperor visited the Southern Park, and sixty attending officials died of heatstroke.

sentences.zh: 以錄尚書事高阿那肱為司徒。

translations.literal: Recorder of the Masters of Writing Gao Anagutai was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Anagutai, recorder of the Masters of Writing, was appointed minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔開府王師羅使於周。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict dispatched Bearer of the Grand Dignity Wang Shiluo as envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict dispatched Bearer of the Grand Dignity Wang Shiluo as envoy to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，校獵于鄴東。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, a hunting expedition was conducted east of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court conducted a hunting expedition east of Ye.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，陳將吳明徹陷壽陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Chen general Wu Mingche captured Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Chen general Wu Mingche captured Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，殺侍中崔季舒、張彫虎，散騎常侍劉逖、封孝琰，黃門侍郎裴澤、郭遵。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Palace Attendants Cui Jishu and Zhang Diaohu, Regular Attendants Liu Ti and Feng Xiaoyan, and Yellow Gate Gentlemen Pei Ze and Guo Zun were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Palace Attendants Cui Jishu and Zhang Diaohu, Regular Attendants Liu Ti and Feng Xiaoyan, and Yellow Gate Gentlemen Pei Ze and Guo Zun were put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以司徒高阿那肱為右丞相。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the wuyin day, Minister over the Masses Gao Anagutai was made Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuyin day, Minister over the Masses Gao Anagutai was made right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、靺鞨並遣使朝貢，突厥使來求婚。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo and Mojie each sent envoys to pay court tribute, and a Turk envoy came to propose marriage.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Goguryeo and Mojie, and a Turk envoy came seeking a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙丑，置左右娥英各一人。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the yichou day, one left and one right Eying were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the first month of spring in the fifth year, one left and one right Eying were established.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the yiwei day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiwei day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 朔州行臺、南安王思好反。

translations.literal: Prince Siho of Nan'an, Provisional Secretariat of Shuozhou, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Siho of Nan'an, head of the Shuozhou provisional secretariat, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 尚書令唐邕等大破思好，思好投水死，焚其屍，並其妻李氏。

translations.literal: Chief Minister of the Secretariat Tang Yong and others greatly defeated Siho; Siho threw himself into the water and died, his corpse was burned, and so was his wife Lady Li.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Tang Yong and others routed Siho; Siho drowned himself, his corpse was burned, and his wife Lady Li was burned with it.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以尚書令唐邕為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Tang Yong was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Chief Minister Tang Yong was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大旱，晉陽得死魃，長二尺，面頂各二目。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, a great drought struck; in Jinyang a drought demon was captured, two feet long, with two eyes each on its face and crown.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer a severe drought struck; in Jinyang a drought demon was captured two feet long, with two eyes on its face and two on the crown of its head.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，便刻木為其形以獻。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he immediately had a wooden figure carved in its likeness and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he had a wooden figure carved in its likeness and presented it at court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，陳人寇淮北。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Chen forces raided north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Chen forces raided the territory north of the Huai River.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guimao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以高勱為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Gao Mai was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Gao Mai was appointed right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺南陽王綽。

translations.literal: That year, Prince Chuo of Nanyang was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince Chuo of Nanyang was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六年春三月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the sixth year, on the yihai day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the sixth year, on the yihai day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，烹妖賊鄭子饒於都市。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, the sorcerer-rebel Zheng Zirao was boiled alive in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the sorcerer-rebel Zheng Zirao was boiled alive in the public marketplace.

sentences.zh: 是月，周人來聘。

translations.literal: That month, envoys from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: That month envoys from Zhou arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，以中書監陽休之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, Director of the Secretariat Yang Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, Director of the Secretariat Yang Xiuzhi was appointed right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，靺鞨遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the Mojie sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, envoys from Mojie arrived to pay court tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，冀、定、趙、幽、滄、瀛六州大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, the six provinces of Ji, Ding, Zhao, You, Cang, and Ying suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, Ji, Ding, Zhao, You, Cang, and Ying Provinces were struck by severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 是月，周師入洛川，屯芒山，攻逼洛城，縱火船焚浮橋，河橋絕。

translations.literal: That month, Zhou forces entered Luochuan, encamped at Mangshan, pressed the attack on Luoyang, sent fire ships to burn the pontoon bridge, and the river bridge was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou troops entered Luochuan, encamped at Mangshan, and pressed the siege of Luoyang; fire ships burned the pontoon bridge and severed the river crossing.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，遣右丞相高阿那肱自晉陽禦之，師次河陽，周師夜遁。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the jichou day, Right Chancellor Gao Anaggon was dispatched from Jinyang to meet them; his army halted at Heyang, and the Zhou forces fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the jichou day, Right Chancellor Gao Anaggon was sent from Jinyang to oppose them; his army halted at Heyang, and the Zhou troops withdrew under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以司空趙彥深為司徒，斛律阿列羅為司空。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Zhao Yanshen was made Minister over the Masses, and Hulu Alieluo was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Zhao Yanshen was appointed minister over the masses, and Hulu Alieluo was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以軍國資用不足，稅關市、舟車、山澤、鹽鐵、店肆，輕重各有差，開酒禁。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, because military and state expenses were insufficient, taxes were levied on market tolls, boats and carts, mountains and marshes, salt and iron, and shops, with varying rates of severity, and the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, with military and state coffers empty, the court taxed market tolls, transport, natural resources, salt and iron, and shops at graded rates, and lifted the ban on wine.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬辰，詔去秋已來，水潦人饑不自立者，所在付大寺及諸富戶濟其性命。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the renchen day, an edict declared that since the previous autumn, wherever people rendered destitute by flood and famine could not support themselves, local authorities were to entrust them to major monasteries and wealthy households to preserve their lives.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the renchen day, an edict ordered that flood and famine victims unable to support themselves since the previous autumn be placed with major monasteries and wealthy households for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，括雜戶女年二十已下十四已上未嫁悉集省，隱匿者家長處死刑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinyou day, unmarried women of miscellaneous households aged fourteen to twenty were all rounded up and sent to the capital; any family head who concealed them was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinyou day, unmarried women of miscellaneous households between fourteen and twenty were conscripted and sent to the capital, and any family head who hid them faced execution.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，風從西北起，發屋拔樹，五日乃止。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the bingyin day, a wind rose from the northwest, tearing off roofs and uprooting trees; after five days it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingyin day, a windstorm from the northwest tore off roofs and uprooted trees and did not subside until the fifth day.

sentences.zh: 夏六月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on the wushen day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month of summer, the wushen day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，司徒趙彥深薨。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Minister over the Masses Zhao Yanshen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Minister over the Masses Zhao Yanshen died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，大雨霖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou day, heavy rains fell for many days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou day, torrential rains fell for many days.

sentences.zh: 是月，以水澇遣使巡撫流亡人戶。

translations.literal: That month, because of flood damage, envoys were dispatched to tour and succor displaced households.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because of flooding, envoys were sent to tour the provinces and aid displaced households.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 雉集於御坐，獲之，有司不敢以聞。

translations.literal: A pheasant alighted on the imperial seat; it was caught, and the officials dared not report it.
translations.idiomatic: A pheasant alighted on the imperial throne; it was caught, but the officials dared not report the omen.

sentences.zh: 詔營邯鄲宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Handan Palace to be built.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered construction of the Handan Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，帝大狩於祁連池。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingchen day, the emperor conducted a great hunt at Qilian Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingchen day, the emperor held a great hunt at Qilian Pool.

sentences.zh: 周師攻晉州。

translations.literal: Zhou forces attacked Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou forces attacked Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝還晉陽。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the emperor returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the emperor returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，出兵，大集晉祠。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, troops were mobilized and massed at the Jin Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the army was mobilized and assembled at the Jin Shrine.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝發晉陽。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the emperor set out from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the emperor marched out from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，帝列陣而行，上雞棲原，與周齊王憲相對，至夜不戰，周師斂陣而退。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the emperor drew up his battle lines and advanced to Jiqiyuan, facing Prince Xian of Zhou across the field; they stood opposite each other until night without fighting, and the Zhou army withdrew its formations and retreated.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the emperor formed battle lines and advanced to Jiqiyuan, facing Prince Xian of Zhou; the two armies faced off until nightfall without engaging, and the Zhou troops then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月，周武帝退還長安，留偏師守晉州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Emperor Wu of Zhou withdrew to Chang'an, leaving a detached force to hold Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Emperor Wu of Zhou withdrew to Chang'an, leaving a detached force to garrison Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 高阿那肱等圍晉州城。

translations.literal: Gao Anaggon and others besieged the city of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Anaggon and others laid siege to Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，帝至圍所。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the emperor reached the siege camp.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the emperor arrived at the siege lines.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，周武帝來救晉州，庚戌，戰於城南，我軍大敗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, Emperor Wu of Zhou came to relieve Jin Province; on the gengxu day they fought south of the city, and our army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, Emperor Wu of Zhou marched to relieve Jin Province; on the gengxu day battle was joined south of the city, and the Northern Qi army was routed.

sentences.zh: 帝棄軍先還。
